title: Junctions of Ruun
description: A vast swath of custom signange for MTS/IV
body:
Junctions of Ruun requires Immersive Vehicles to function properly

JUNCTIONS OF RUUN

Junctions of Ruun adds a vast color pallet of signage for your Immersive Vehicles road networks! All signage is designed with symbolic icons as well as blank versions with text fields to allow clear legibility on your roads.

CONTENTS

All signs come with blank variants with text fields if you cannot find an appropriate symbol for your use case! Posts - Standard Break-away Post Junction Signs - Red Stop - Yellow Stop - White Stop - Red Crossbucks - Black Crossbucks - Yield Sign Caution Diamonds
With Black and Blue symbol colors and Construction and School Zone variants where applicable - Clearance - Grade Up - Grade Down - Bear Territory - Goats Crossing - Deer Crossing - Byciclist Warning - Pedestrian Crossing - Tractor Traffic - Trucks Entering - End of Road - Pavement Ends - Pavement Begins - Tunnel Ahead - Speedbumps - Grooved Pavement - Uneven Surface - Water Over Road - Slippery Conditions - Rockslide Warning - Road Narrows - Lane Ends (Left, Right) - Roadway Shifts (Left, Right) - Gradual Turn (Left, Right) - Sharp Turn (Left, Right) - Hairpin (Left, Right) - Squiggly Road (Left, Right) - Hidden Drive (Left, Right) - Fork (Left, Right) - T Junction (Approach, Left, Right) - 4 Way Junction - Wye Junction - Railroad Crossing - Rail Silence Zone - Diagonal Railroad Crossing (Left, Right) - T Junction with Crossing (Left, Right) - 4 Way Junction with Crossing (Left, Right) - Roundabout Ahead - Stop Ahead - Signal Ahead - Flagger - Roadwork Circular Signage
With multiple colors for both allowed and restriction signage - Allow Pedestrians - Allow Bycicles - Allow Horses - Allow Tractors - Allow Transit - Allow Commercial Traffic - Allow Vehicles - Allow Passing - Allowed Moves At Junction (Straight, Left, Right, U-Turn) - Allow Parking (Left, Right, Both) - Parking Lot - Unrestricted Speed - No Pedestrians - No Bycicles - No Horses - No Tractors - No Commercial Traffic - No Vehicles - No Passing - No Stopping - Restricted Moves At Junction (Straight, Left, Right, U-Turn) - No Parking (Left, Right, Both) - No Entry/Wrong Way - Blank Speedlimit Signs Horizontal Rectangular Signage
Comes in Blue, White, Black, and Construction Orange - Diverging Roadways - One Way (Left, Right) - Bidirectional Roadway - Allow Turning Left and Right Vertical Rectangular Signage
Comes in Blue, White, and Construction Orange - Keep Left - Keep Right - Allowed Moves At Junction (Straight, Left, Left and Straight, Right, Right and Straight)

NOTES

This pack is done as a hobby and will be updated inconsistently and as I see fit. Usage and redistribution in any form is allowed, just credit Iron Horse Dev Group and link back here in some form =) Discord Patreon Iron Horse Dev Group
